# Synthetic task-context proof v1

This fixture was generated by the frozen C33a executable against an explicit
local loopback Provider with synthetic credentials and project content. It
contains a seed turn, a two-objective turn with two real independent Tool
outcomes, and two subsequent A-focused turns. The old A request contains B's
output under the historical v1 attribution rule. The Tool batch also produces
an incremental request after a Full request.

The manifest records the C33a product manifest and executable SHA-256 and the
SHA-256 of every preserved file. Original Session events, task selection and
capture facts, audit and content blobs, Project identity, Tool outcomes, and
the synthetic effect-count file are preserved byte for byte; nothing was
reconstructed by rewriting a later proof version. Cache and runtime lock files
are excluded. The generator and original-path development project are retained
in the local task evidence directory, not needed to read this fixture.

Project identity is tied to its original canonical path. The portable private
replay regression supplies that recorded identity directly to the existing
verified replay owner and publishes the original bytes into a temporary local
ArtifactStore. A CLI Resume cannot relocate this frozen project without
changing its source proofs; original-path CLI upgrade verification is a
separate local development check. Neither proves Live model behavior.
